about:
Founded in 1961, Clifco Sheet Metal Manufacturing began in Ogden, Utah, as a manufacturer of sheet metal HVAC ductwork and fittings. In 2012 the company moved its operations to Salt Lake City, and its headquarters are now in Taylorsville, Utah.

Clifco specializes in fabricating rectangular duct, spiral pipe, and fittings from galvanized steel, aluminum, PVS-coated duct, and stainless steel. The company maintains a full product line of both rectangular and spiral duct and fittings, and also produces custom ductwork for residential and commercial applications.

The business serves the commercial and residential HVAC sectors, providing ductwork and fittings for a range of projects. Its catalog includes aluminum pipe and fittings, galvanized pipe and fittings, and PVS-coated spiral pipe.

Clifco states that it differentiates itself through quick, efficient, and friendly service, and notes that it will work with customers to accommodate custom requirements not covered by its standard offerings.
